name: Yinzi: Ming

categories.label: Yangtze Transport Capacity levels
categories.labelVi: Cấp vận chuyển sông Dương Tử

categories.label: Unexported Goods
categories.hint: Goods in Workshops or on ships in port; 1 Wealth each.

categories.label: Foreign Market exported Goods
categories.hint: Sum of Wealth from your Goods by their slot on the Asian and European Foreign Market boards.

categories.label: Ambassador Negotiation
categories.hint: Negotiation level (1-4) x number of distinct destinations you exported at least 1 Good to (max 6).

categories.label: Caravan Escort Bonus
categories.hint: Wealth on the Escort Bonus token if you have the most Overseers at the Caravanserai (enter 0 / 2 / 4 as shown).

categories.label: Completed Silk Road Caravans
categories.hint: Sum of Wealth on completed Caravan tiles; uncompleted give nothing.

categories.label: Bribe the Administration
categories.hint: Most Overseers in Corrupt Administration: enter 4 (sole winner), 2 (tied) or 0.

categories.label: Silver bars
categories.hint: 1 Wealth per Silver bar after converting Copper at current rate.

tiebreakers.description: Player furthest ahead in turn order in the final round wins.
tiebreakers.descriptionVi: Người đi trước trong thứ tự lượt ở vòng cuối thắng.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Game ends after round 4; fulfil any kept Caravans first. Bribe the Administration is entered as 4 (sole most Overseers), 2 (tied) or 0. Exported goods slot values depend on market position so they are entered as a total. Solo and Natural Disaster optional rule not modelled. Verified only against RulesPal rulebook text; official PDF not retrieved.

uiHintReason: Scoring pad rows are direct counts; no per-tile modelling.
winConditionVi: Điểm cao nhất thắng. Ván kết thúc sau vòng 4 (hoàn thành Caravan còn giữ trước).
